Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp I level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "📡 Telecomunicazioni e reti", solid fill #6A1B9A, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:

  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente descrive il funzionamento delle…" | "analogico/digitale" | "modulazione" | "protocolli"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "protocollo di rete / network protocol" | "segnale digitale / digital signal"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Mappa la copertura WiFi della scuola" | "misura la potenza del segnale in 8 punti…" | "Professione futura: Digital Communication Specialist"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "reti" | "Internet" | "telecomunicazioni" | "protocolli" | "protocollo di rete"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #6A1B9A on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
